scripts.dev: pnpm generate-tokens && concurrently -n v,c "pnpm run dev:vite" "pnpm run dev:convex"
scripts.dev:public: concurrently -n app,t "pnpm run dev" "pnpm run dev:tunnel"
scripts.build: pnpm generate-tokens && node scripts/render-logo-png.mjs && tsx scripts/render-og-default-png.mts && vite build && cp instrument.server.mjs .output/server
scripts.build:cf: pnpm generate-tokens && node scripts/render-logo-png.mjs && tsx scripts/render-og-default-png.mts && CF_PAGES=1 vite build
scripts.preview:cf: dotenv -e ../../.env.local -- pnpm run build:cf && wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.deploy: pnpm build:cf && wrangler pages deploy dist && pnpm run check:edge-cache
scripts.test:e2e: dotenv -e ../../.env.local -e ../../.env.test -- pnpm exec playwright test -c playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:smoke: dotenv -e ../../.env.local -e ../../.env.test -- pnpm exec playwright test -c playwright.config.ts tests/e2e/public-smoke.spec.ts tests/e2e/signed-out-smoke.spec.ts tests/e2e/seo-smoke.spec.ts tests/e2e/sitemap-invariants.spec.ts tests/e2e/a11y-smoke.spec.ts tests/e2e/a11y-authed.spec.ts tests/e2e/auth-smoke.spec.ts tests/e2e/prediction-flow-smoke.spec.ts --project=public-chromium --project=mobile-chromium --project=auth-chromium --workers=1
scripts.test:e2e:headed: dotenv -e ../../.env.local -e ../../.env.test -- pnpm exec playwright test -c playwright.config.ts --headed
scripts.test:e2e:ui: dotenv -e ../../.env.local -e ../../.env.test -- pnpm exec playwright test -c playwright.config.ts --ui
scripts.dev:signin:in-leagues: dotenv -e ../../.env.local -- pnpm exec tsx scripts/dev-signin.ts in-leagues
scripts.dev:signin:solo: dotenv -e ../../.env.local -- pnpm exec tsx scripts/dev-signin.ts solo
scripts.dev:signin:stale: dotenv -e ../../.env.local -- pnpm exec tsx scripts/dev-signin.ts stale
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:barrels && pnpm run lint:tokens && pnpm run lint:cached-reads && pnpm run lint:clerk-free && pnpm run lint:css-layers && pnpm --dir ../.. exec oxlint -c .oxlintrc.json apps/web/src apps/web/server apps/web/vite.config.ts
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm --dir ../.. exec oxlint -c .oxlintrc.json apps/web/src apps/web/server apps/web/vite.config.ts --fix
scripts.fix: pnpm run format && pnpm run lint:fix
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint
